posts.text:
Humanoid robots are officially grounded across major US carriers.

American Airlines has joined United, Delta, and Southwest in explicitly banning humanoid and animal-like robots from commercial cabins.

The industry-wide push cites severe lithium-ion fire risks and closes emotional support loopholes—following the viral stunt where Aaron Mehdizadeh flew his Booster K1 ("Stewie") on Southwest.
